QuestInfo.name: Cutting a Swath
QuestInfo.0: Shingen is exhausted from non-stop fighting. You need to get him back to the safety of Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.1: Shingen is too exhausted to fight anymore. You need to cut a swath through the monsters so he can escape.
QuestInfo.2: You got Shingen back safely to Momijigaoka. Yukimura should feel better now.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#Can proceed to The Tiger Daimyou quest
